description: This file defines an interface 'JsonKey' which models a key in a JSON object, providing methods to create a new key from a character sequence and to convert the key to a JSON pointer.

classes.name: JsonKey
classes.description: An interface representing a JSON key, extending CharSequence, with static and instance methods for key manipulation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method to create a JsonKey instance from a character sequence, delegating to JsonFactory for creation.

methods.name: asPointer
methods.description: Instance method that converts the JSON key into a JSON pointer with one level, e.g., 'foo' -> '/foo'.
